newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: German top Czech politicians in soccer friendly.
newsitem.headline: German top Czech politicians in soccer friendly.

text.p: Visiting German politicians trounced their Czech counterparts on Sunday in a friendly soccer match that offered a break from the more serious goal of negotiating a joint reconciliation agreement between the two countries.

For months, Bonn and Prague have been trying to agree on a text aimed at setting aside lingering resentments over both the Nazi invasion of Czechoslovakia and the expulsion of millions of ethnic Germans from the country after World War Two.

Chancellor Helmut Kohl says the declaration will be ready this year. Czech Deputy Foreign Minister and team captain Alexandr Vondra said on Sunday that he saw no reason why the Czech-German document could not be signed at the executive level by the end of the year.
Representatives of Germany's opposition Greens party dominated the football match but only broke it open late in the first half with two quick goals before coasting to a 3-0 victory.

"I've come to understand that Germany, as a democratic state for decades, is in a slightly different situation and that politicians there have far more time for football," Czech parliamentary deputy Michal Lobkowicz said after the match.
